q2_gaps: bare collective "together" on a coordinated subject whose predicate is a POSSESSION state: the collective form is specified as one event with multiple Agent atoms, but the same section reserves Holder for own/have/lack subjects, and the instruction set never says which role the collective form takes when the verb is not an Agent verb
notes: Collective (one event, two subject-role atoms) is correct for bare "together", the two Holder atoms are the right generalization given "never default to Agent/Patient", and the bare simple present correctly gets no status atom. The group witness is named sk_children_1 although only one group is in play, where the stated default is sk_group_<n>.
